note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in Co. Londonderry took place on Tuesday 2 June 1936 and Mr. A. Mitchell, returning officer, declared the results on Wednesday 3 June. Three of the twenty-three divisions were contested; the rest were filled at the nominations. Filed on 1936-06-02, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Londonderry that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Fourteen further divisions were filled unopposed at nomination (Londonderry Sentinel, 30 April 1936, p. 2). The six divisions with no nomination (Ballykelly, Bellarena, Benone, Feeny, Glenshane, Straw) are recorded from the Derry Journal's reports of the new council's meetings (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). No nomination: the retiring councillor was 'considered to have been re-elected' (Londonderry Sentinel, 30 April 1936, p. 2). Division inferred from the 2 June 1933 return (John M'Nicholl, Ballymoney Free Press, 11 May 1933, p. 1); the Derry Journal's reports of the new council's meetings name him as a member from June 1936. No co-option or by-election for this division was found in 1936-39. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
